specs.name: Original Runtime
specs.quote: After eleven months, my Aster One ran for 14 minutes on its normal setting instead of the 45 minutes it delivered when new.

risks.title: Reduced Runtime
risks.body: The battery runtime decreased from the original specification after extended use.
risks.advice: Verify if a replacement battery restores the original runtime.

sources.quote: After eleven months, my Aster One ran for 14 minutes on its normal setting instead of the 45 minutes it delivered when new.
The replacement battery restored the original runtime.
Two Aster One owners reported shortened battery runtime after a year of use.

risks.title: Cracked dust-bin latches
risks.body: cracked dust-bin latches were replaced on four Aster One units built in 2025.
risks.advice: Inspect the dust-bin latch mechanism for cracks or damage.
